result:
The chart type gallery now also appears on a saved trends insight in view mode, in place of the dropdown. I haven't run any tests or the type checker, and I haven't opened it in the UI.

The gallery decides whether to show itself in `chartAlternativesLogic.ts`, in the `isEditableSurface` selector. That selector required edit mode, so view mode fell back to the dropdown. I removed that requirement. `canShowAlternatives` is the only consumer of `isEditableSurface`. The gallery is still gated on:

- the `PRODUCT_ANALYTICS_CHART_ALTERNATIVES` feature flag,
- the insight being a trends insight,
- the insight not being embedded, shared or on a dashboard,
- the user being able to edit the insight.

Edit mode behaves as before. The dropdown remains as the fallback wherever the gallery doesn't apply, such as dashboards, shared and embedded views, insight types other than trends, and users who can't edit.

I did not add a test. I didn't check whether the existing tests need a change. `ChartAlternatives.test.tsx` and `chartPreviewsLogic.test.ts` still pass `editMode: true` and don't cover the view-mode case.
